status: Rejected; all production source changes restored. Only the standalone diagnostic candidate and benchmark/check tool are retained.
decision: Component savings did not give a reliable whole-refresh improvement. The initial variant gained about0.5% overall at native145 but slowed basis reconstruction about6%. After compile-time encoding/dense dispatch and allocation-order revisions, the final variant is about0.3% slower overall and basis remains slower. Do not promote this combined tensor/gadget prototype.
candidate: Skip RNS encodes/forward transforms of ciphertext components that are zero moduloQ and inverse/CRT work for structurally zero tensor outputs. Reuse the ordinary spectrum for pointer-identical squarings by canonical multiplication with R^2, producing the same Montgomery spectrum. Dense distinct inputs dispatch to a separate unpruned specialization. The full-replay prototype also cleared/returned from the gadget when no primary digits were active. All arithmetic, moduli, scales, key rows, approximation and gates stayed unchanged.
experiment_scope: The full comparison includes both tensor shortcuts and zero-gadget early return; it does not isolate their individual whole-evaluation effects. The versioned standalone tool isolates tensor arithmetic only. Timings refer to the preserved measured binaries/source snapshots; the exported test-only namespace is separately checked and is not the original timed link layout.
component_method: N16384,Q385/341/165; fixture0 ordinary dense distinct operands, fixture1 transparent right mask moduloQ with noncanonical high storage, fixture2 aliased dense square. Actual previous tensor function preserved in benchmark. Warm both, then legacy/candidate/candidate/legacy with5 samples per block,10 per policy. Compare every output outside the timer. Single1 pinned P core, single internally24-thread call, and32 independent calls in one24-thread outer team. Scalar single-call timings and batching are different contexts.
replay_method: Each phase uses four process runs in legacy/candidate/candidate/legacy order. Each warms native112 then measures112/145/145/112; exclude warmups, four samples per binary and native width. Fixed8/8 S2C, sparse Tanh4 roots7/9/10/15, accumulated basis,24 pinned logical CPU threads. Same retained input and raw keys. No overlapping compilation, unit/decoder/profiler with timed replay. Algorithm timings exclude key/input loading, public cache setup, serialization, independent decoding and remaining square.

operation_scope.interpretation: Only8 of248 tree products have a transparent beta operand. Four of16 basis tensors are squares. Large isolated savings for these products cannot be applied as a whole-refresh percentage.

exported_tools.arguments: --check validates; no argument benchmarks single calls;32 benchmarks an outer batch. Set OpenMP/pinning explicitly. No key generation or encryption.
exported_tools.scope: N16 Q1/93/165/385/440 and N16384 Q93/165/385,11 fixtures each. Random noncanonical input, either/both masks zero, either body zero, whole-zero operands, aliased dense/transparent/zero squares and stale-output clearing. AVX2 full-degree dense cases compare with previous RNS and FFT; N16 also uses independent integer schoolbook. Scalar RNS full-degree cases use8 active coefficients per component at both ring ends and compare all coefficients with independent schoolbook plus prior RNS.

scalar_reference_diagnostic.cause: With USE_INTERLEAVED_FORMAT and -mno-avx2, the configured FFT emits interleaved complex pairs but current MulInFD/FMAInFD fallback arithmetic assumes split real/imaginary halves. An independent (2+3i)*(5+7i) layout check expects(-11,29) and fails. Initial RNS candidate and old RNS agree; failure is their full-degree FFT reference. N16 takes a direct small-ring path and passes.
scalar_reference_diagnostic.resolution: Standalone tool explicitly detects the unsupported reference layout and uses a sparse full-degree exact integer oracle for scalar RNS checks. Production FFT code is unchanged. This is not a non-AVX portability certification of the full FFT backend.

scalar_mode.oracle: Dense N16 and sparse N16384 exact integer schoolbook; legacy RNS comparison. FFT reference used only for N16 where it takes the direct small-ring path.

restoration.scope: Restored replay binary is exactly the original qualified binary; no extra encrypted replay after restoration is needed.

limits: One CPU/input; four paired samples per binary and width. Whole changes are small and vary by implementation version. Internally threaded dense Q341 component timing regresses despite other isolated gains; actual tree uses outer batches there. No CUDA, security certification, matched-hardware paper comparison or achievement of remaining10x objective.
next_investigation: Prioritize dense batched gadget work and key-spectrum traffic, which affects ordinary products, over more special-case tensor shortcuts.
